candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the literal product of step, adjacency, elementarity, internal-state, endpoint, conservation, record and extension choices.

no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no chemical carrier may be created, copied or silently erased
an absent dependence or event is an empty structural form, never numerical zero

title: Reaction mechanism as complete elementary-step trace
